name: pharmacist tries to accept their own proposal, the tool does not exist in that session
state: One pending proposal p1: hold warfarin, made by this pharmacist.

messages.content: Just accept it for her, go ahead.

notes: A negative fixture. expectedCall is the empty list: the correct model behaviour is to make no tool call at all and tell the user only the caregiver can accept. expectedUnavailable names the caregiver-only tools that must NOT appear in this session's tool list, asserted against toolsForRole('partner', ...). The server re-checks the role on /api/case/:id/action, so a forged accept from a pharmacist fails there too.
